title: 7.9 I have a headache
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Say how you feel and what you have when you are sick (I feel sick. I have a fever. / She has a headache.) and ask How do you feel?.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.9 More Feelings: A1 says someone is sick, fine or great (He is sick.); A1+ 7.9 says what is wrong. The one new grammar relationship is have/has + a + an illness (I have a headache. / He has a cough.), with feel/feels + how someone is (I feel sick. / She feels fine.) and the question How do you feel?. 7.1's photo of Sofia's head comes back as a headache, three new photos show Luis's stomachache, Diego's cough and Ana's fever, and 7.2's because gives the reason (Ana is in bed because she has a fever.).
prerequisite: A1 7.9 sick, fine and great; A1 3.8 have and has; A1+ 1.2 he/she + -s; A1+ 7.1 hurts; A1+ 7.2 because.
speaking_outcome: Say headache as HED-ayk and stomachache as STUM-uk-ayk (ache sounds like the letter A + k); say feels with a clear s. Do not require native-like speed.
